doc: Gemma-4 Unified (Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration, genesis 8 #4) read as its text decoder: model.language_model.* under the gemma4-unified-text block; the image embedder (model.vision_embedder.*: patch LayerNorm, patch_dense, 2-D position table, pos_norm; model.embed_vision.*) and the audio embedder (model.embed_audio.*) are not lowered on this text-only route; the wrapper's tie_word_embeddings decides tying (the 12B ties). The image path is a separate prefix stage (ATTN_PREFIX_LM_V1 over the image tokens), not built here.
